rule.statement: The court held that the petitioner failed to establish that his fundamental rights were infringed.
rule.supporting_quote: The Petitioner had failed to establish that his fundamental rights enshrined under Article 12(1) and 14(1)(h) have been infringed.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Article 12(1), 12(2), 14(1) (g) and 14(1) (h) read with Articles 17 and 126 of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
